purpose: Increase P1C01 lived-in Shire visual density without increasing full-AI population or introducing a second world-life owner.

source_scope.world: Pastoral hills, lanes, farms, Hobbit-holes, gardens, readable low-threat exploration and chapter-state variation.
source_scope.systems: Believable authored routine/world detail with bounded simulation; density quality should use instancing, culling and simplified distant presentation.
source_scope.canon_boundary: P1C01 remains the existing F1-01/F1-02/F1-03 aggregation. This car changes dressing only and owns no locked story outcome.

architecture.living_world_director: Ambient population budgets, pooling and micro-events remain sole authority.
architecture.implementation: AWorldDetailCluster HISM actors using already-resident meshes exposed by ShirePrototypeWorldBuilder.

asset_policy.source: Existing ProductionCommon* mesh pointers resolved from already-resident soft object paths.
asset_policy.missing_asset_behavior: Skip that category; do not synchronously load it.
